## Summary

The May 8 and November 7, 2026 captures document Klarna for US Link customers in Payment Links, Stripe-hosted Checkout and the Payment Element. Turning on Link automatically enables Klarna subject to eligibility. Link evaluates which methods to display for the business and transaction, and Klarna offers plans subject to its own criteria. Unselect **Pay later with Klarna** in Link settings to disable it.

## Integration and identity

Both generic Link API integration forms list Klarna as a possible funding method. The dedicated Klarna on Link guide limits its checkout availability to the three surfaces above. The Express Checkout Element guide lists separate Link and Klarna buttons, and neither that list nor standalone Klarna's geography and plan guidance extends the Klarna-on-Link surface list. [[source-stripe-link-payment-integrations]] · [[source-stripe-express-checkout-link]] · [[source-stripe-klarna]]

The Link funding group reference lists Klarna as `lfsg_004`. On a Charge, the funding group appears under `payment_method_details.link.funding_source_group` for Link as a payment method or `payment_method_details.card.wallet.link.funding_source_group` for a card-specific Link integration. The code classifies the underlying funding group. The Charge ID and payment method type remain separate. [[source-stripe-link-payment-methods]]

## Customer flows

- **First Klarna use by an existing Link customer.** Choose **Pay later** and **Continue to payment plans**, confirm identity, create a Klarna account, select an offered plan, review and click **Pay**. General Link enrollment and authentication are separate.
- **Returning Klarna on Link customer.** Klarna details are saved in Link. Choose **Pay later**, review the prefilled details and click **Pay**. The guide shows the customer returning to the merchant success page.

Account creation, plan selection, saved details and return are customer flow steps. Verify payment separately. The April 20, 2026 Checkout fulfillment guide applies to Hosted Checkout and Payment Links. It uses server-side Checkout Session `payment_status` and webhooks to fulfill successful payments. The November canonical capture is a variant index. [[source-stripe-checkout-fulfillment]]

## Merchant funding and payout

Both Klarna on Link captures say Stripe immediately credits the full purchase amount minus Stripe fees to the merchant's Stripe account after the customer's payment method issuer authorizes the Klarna payment. The merchant does not wait for Klarna to collect installments. The guide's “Future payments” section describes Klarna collecting those installments.

The separate November Link integrations guide describes successful payments settling to the Stripe balance on the card-payment timeline. The standalone Klarna overview describes accepted-payment net credit to the Stripe account and specifies standard payout timing. The guides leave open how the Link-specific Stripe-account credit relates in timing or sequence to the general Link settlement description. Neither Stripe-account statement establishes immediate payout to an external bank. These dated statements provide no particular transaction outcome or off-session charge workflow. [[source-stripe-link-payment-integrations]] · [[source-stripe-klarna]]

payments-link-klarna.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/klarna, Link customers in the United States can use Klarna with Payment Links, Stripe Checkout (Hosted) and Payment Element. Turning on Link enables Klarna subject to eligibility. Merchants can unselect Pay later with Klarna in Link settings. An existing Link customer using Klarna there for the first time selects Pay later and Continue to payment plans, confirms identity, creates a Klarna account, chooses an offered plan, reviews and clicks Pay. Returning customers review Link-saved prefilled details, click Pay, and are shown returning to the merchant's success page. Both flows require separate payment-state verification. The May 8 and November 7 captures say that, after the customer's payment method issuer authorizes the Klarna payment, Stripe immediately credits the full purchase amount minus Stripe fees to the merchant's Stripe account, without waiting for Klarna's installment collection (old raw line 58 and new raw line 59). This is the Klarna on Link funding statement. The general Link integrations guide separately describes successful payments settling to Stripe balance on the card-payment timeline (raw/stripe-payments-link-link-payment-integrations-2026-11-07.md:9). Standalone Klarna separately gives standard payout timing (raw/stripe-payments-klarna-2026-11-07.md:37-39). None of those documentation statements verifies a particular authorization, capture or external payout. Sandbox cards are Visa credit 4242424242424242 for installments and unbranded debit 4687388888888881 for financing, each with a three-digit CVC and a future expiry (new raw lines 5-26 and new raw lines 28-59). These facts match May (old raw lines 4-25 and old raw lines 27-58). The revised source-stripe-klarna-on-link.md preserves the surface and flow outline, adds eligibility and the funding prerequisite, deduction and Stripe-account destination, and distinguishes existing Link identity from first use of Klarna and sandbox fixtures.
payments-link-klarna.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/klarna, November adds capture metadata, reformats the unchanged test table and changes seven local image references to CDN URLs. The captions, configuration, tests and payment copy are substantively unchanged (old raw lines 4-58 and new raw lines 5-59). The revised source-stripe-klarna-on-link.md dates both asset references and retains merchant and session eligibility, the US Link customer and three-surface scope, and the dated funding condition. The May 8 and November 7 captures say that, after the customer's payment method issuer authorizes the Klarna payment, Stripe immediately credits the full purchase amount minus Stripe fees to the merchant's Stripe account, without waiting for Klarna's installment collection (old raw line 58 and new raw line 59). This is the Klarna on Link funding statement. The general Link integrations guide separately describes successful payments settling to Stripe balance on the card-payment timeline (raw/stripe-payments-link-link-payment-integrations-2026-11-07.md:9). Standalone Klarna separately gives standard payout timing (raw/stripe-payments-klarna-2026-11-07.md:37-39). None of those documentation statements verifies a particular authorization, capture or external payout. The revised source and concept suggestions qualify generic Link integration and Express Checkout button lists and cross-link standalone Klarna. The dedicated guide's three-surface scope governs Klarna inside Link. The Link payment methods reference classifies Klarna as funding source group `lfsg_004`, reported on `Charge.payment_method_details.link.funding_source_group` for Link as a payment method or `Charge.payment_method_details.card.wallet.link.funding_source_group` for a card-specific Link integration. This code classifies the underlying Link funding source. The Charge identifier and top-level payment method identity are separate (raw/stripe-payments-link-link-payment-methods-2026-11-07.md:17-38). A selected plan, sandbox card, Link-saved details or customer return does not verify issuer approval, charge, capture, settlement, fulfillment or bank payout. Companion Hosted Checkout and Payment Links fulfillment guidance verifies Checkout Session payment_status and uses webhooks (raw/stripe-checkout-fulfillment-2025.md:21-38,233-253). The guide gives no Link-specific API or SDK version requirement and does not establish recurring or off-session merchant charges.

concept_suggestions.proposed_markdown: **Klarna on Link**: For eligible US Link customers in Payment Links, Stripe-hosted Checkout and Payment Element. Turning on Link enables Klarna subject to eligibility. Disable it in Link settings under **Pay later with Klarna**. The May and November guides describe immediate net credit to the merchant’s Stripe account after issuer authorization, without waiting for Klarna installments. Express Checkout lists Klarna and Link as separate buttons. See [[source-stripe-klarna-on-link]] for the funding, UI and sandbox test boundaries.
